name: campaign-hub-mapgen
description: Headless map renderer for Campaign Hub. Runs the SAME generator source the browser uses (../lib, ../core) against a native canvas, validates every render against RULES.md, and serves PNG + metadata.
//: devDependencies: the design agent is a batch review tool, not part of serving a map -- it stays out of the runtime image so the render path carries no API client and no key.
